name: Apple
summary: Apple is a US consumer technology company. Its [Apple Intelligence](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/06/introducing-apple-intelligence-for-iphone-ipad-and-mac/) suite adds generative AI features to iPhone, iPad and Mac.

incidents.title: Apple Intelligence Notification Summaries Produced False News Headlines
incidents.summary: Apple's AI notification summaries showed false headlines under the names of news organizations, including a false BBC alert that Luigi Mangione had shot himself. After complaints, Apple paused summaries for news and entertainment apps in January 2025.
incidents.description: Apple Intelligence summaries of iPhone notifications showed incorrect headlines under the names of news organizations. One summary falsely told readers, under the BBC's name, that Luigi Mangione had shot himself, and [the BBC complained to Apple](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq5ggew08eyo). After more complaints from press groups, [Apple disabled the summaries for news and entertainment apps](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/01/16/apple-disables-ai-notifications-for-news-in-its-beta-iphone-software.html) in its iOS 18.3 beta.

timeline.title: False BBC alert and complaint
timeline.description: A summary falsely says, under the BBC's name, that Luigi Mangione shot himself. The BBC complains to Apple.

timeline.title: Apple promises a clarifying update
timeline.description: Apple responds in January and promises an update that makes the role of AI in summaries clearer. Critics say this is not enough.

timeline.title: Summaries paused for news apps
timeline.description: Apple disables notification summaries for news and entertainment apps in the iOS 18.3 beta.

timeline.title: BBC welcomes the pause
timeline.description: A BBC spokesperson says the BBC is pleased that Apple listened to its concerns.
